programmes.programName: PhD in Engineering - Engineering Systems Management
programmes.evidence: The current official Engineering Systems Management PhD explicitly addresses fundamental research in Supply Chain Management, Sustainable Construction Project Management and Smart Cities Management. The programme requires original doctoral dissertation research. Its actual host is the Department of Industrial Engineering, College of Engineering.
limitations: Supply Chain Management is an explicit research field within this degree. A separately awarded SCM doctorate or formal named concentration is not asserted from the description.
